description:
[Trivial] Added missing colons in when running help command

When running "bitcoin-cli help < Command >" some were missing colons behind "Result" & "Examples", inconsistent with most of the commands. Some explanations are also misaligned, but I didn't change that because the escape characters makes it look aligned in the source code and I don't know which would people prefer.
